title: Israel’s Arrest of Journalist Abed Abu Shehadeh Raises Concerns
summary_full: Abed Abu Shehadeh, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, was detained without being charged with a crime, raising concerns that the domestic security service is overstepping its authority.
